## Problem and change

Describe the trigger, intended behavior, and relevant issue (if any).

## Validation

- [ ] Offline tests pass: `uv run --locked python -m pytest`
- [ ] Syntax check passes: `uv run --locked python -m compileall -q src scripts tests`
- [ ] Documentation is updated where behavior or usage changes.

Report commands, results, and anything you could not verify. For experiments,
include dataset/model/config provenance and distinguish synthetic checks from
paper reproduction.
